The Bernalillo County county clerk records New Mexico deeds and mortgages.

Who records deeds in Bernalillo County

  • Bernalillo County Clerk - Recording and Filing records deeds and mortgages.

What we confirmed on the official page

  • Hours Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, closed noon-1:15pm for lunch; public access area 8am-4:45pm
  • Recording fee $25 per document (up to 10 entries); copy $1/page, certified copy $2/document; all payment methods except American Express
  • Record deeds, mortgages, liens, judgments, plats; original signed and notarized with full legal description
  • eRecording via third-party vendors (Simplifile, CSC, Kuvera, ACS, USA Digital Solutions) not for individual use; not an endorsement

Bernalillo County by the numbers

Bernalillo County ranks 1 of 13 nm counties in this guide by population, at about 674,357 people in 301,278 housing units (Census Bureau, 2019-2023). At $268,500, the median home value sits 35% above the nm county median for this guide. The nm county median income is $56,259, and Bernalillo County reports $66,514. Owner-occupancy is 64%, so renters hold about 36% of occupied homes. The median home was built in 1982, about 41 years ago.
